Boutique comfort on Vikas Bhawan Road

An imposing structure of timeless luxury and inspiring architecture, the hotel rises up in steps, echoing the design of a Royal stupa.

Hotel SM Palace is a modern boutique-style hotel in Ghazipur, near Sainik Chauraha (Bhutahiya Tad). It offers the finest accommodation in the city's palace area, with full facilities and many of the city's top attractions within walking distance.

    From spicy tandoori starters to rich, creamy curries and desserts, with a few Italian favourites on the specials list.

    Our specials

    Bruschetta

    Crisp toasted bread piled with diced tomato, garlic and basil, finished with extra virgin olive oil.

    Mediterranean Pizza

    A rich tomato base topped with olives, bell peppers, onions, feta and oregano, baked light and rustic.

    Pesto Pasta

    Al dente pasta tossed in basil pesto with garlic, parmesan and extra virgin olive oil.

    Our story

    The Indian Garden began with a simple idea: a place to gather, share a good meal and feel real Indian hospitality. It grew out of a family kitchen.

    There, recipes passed down through generations carried memories of festivals, family celebrations and quiet Sunday lunches. Those are the flavours the restaurant brings to your table, with tradition and modern comfort side by side.

    The full menu

    Tandoori starters, curries, desserts and more. Open the menu on your phone or scan the code.

    Meet our chef

    Every dish at The Indian Garden has a story, and our head chef is at the centre of them.

    With over 15 years of cooking experience across India's most vibrant food cities, from busy kitchens in Delhi to regional dishes from Kerala to Kashmir, he brings an authentic yet creative touch to traditional Indian cuisine.
